paragraphs.text: Stingerquill is the School of Painful Words at Hexhaven Academy on the Echoverse version of Arcavios . It is aligned and the counterpart of Silverquill . The founder of the school is Ingris Stingerquill .
Ingris Stingerquill founded Stingerquill and established three canons:
Have the last word—at any cost.
An opponent's heartbeat betrays their fears and doubts. Speak and hold power over them.

Stingerquill mages inflict harm by the use of words, using verbal magic to cut apart the bodies and souls of their opponents. Cadets with wide vocabularies, quick reaction times, and sharp communication skills are found in Stingerquill. They are the source of their own power, allowing them to act quickly. Rather than relying on lectures, professors demonstrate skills and cadets break into groups to practice. There are no essays, and exams are spur-of-the-moment. Stingerquill cadets function as Jace's frontline troops. They are often deployed as battlepoets or voxmancers who defend Hexhaven and the villages of Arcavios. Rhythmancers cast magical glyphs through the vibration of the words they speak. Soulbreakers are adept at manipulating someone's emotional state. Cadets embellish their clothes, highlighting their hearts, and accentuate their mouths with jewelry or tattoos.
